title: 绣刃生花 - 分镜脚本

shots.visual_description: 一双女人的手占据整个画面，十指纤长却布满密密麻麻的针眼和老茧。指尖穿针引线，绣布上一朵牡丹即将成形，花瓣层叠，色泽从浅粉渐变至深红。暖黄色灯光从侧面打来，丝线在光中折射出柔和的光泽。画面静谧、专注，每一针落下都带着精确的节奏感。
shots.sound_effects: 丝线穿过绣布的细微声响，时钟滴答声
shots.emotion_note: 宁静专注，暴风雨前的平静
shots.camera_movement: 缓慢推近，从手部中景推至指尖特写
shots.visual_description_en: Extreme close-up of a woman's hands with calloused fingertips and needle marks, threading a silver needle through white silk fabric. A nearly complete peony flower emerges on the embroidery cloth, petals layered in gradient pink to crimson. Warm golden side lighting, silk threads gleaming softly. Shallow depth of field, cinematic quality, traditional Chinese embroidery workshop atmosphere.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, extra fingers, missing fingers, mutated hands, bad anatomy, low quality, watermark

shots.visual_description: 绣坊大门被一脚踹开，四个壮汉鱼贯而入。林薇薇踩着细高跟走在最后，逆光中她的身影像一把黑色的刀。她一脚踏上苏晚刚绣好的牡丹绣品，鞋跟碾过花心，丝线断裂。苏晚扑过去想拉开她的脚，被壮汉一把推倒在地，指尖被散落的绣针扎破，鲜血一滴滴落在白色绣品上。绣坊内光线昏暗，门外强光涌入形成强烈明暗对比。
shots.dialogue: 苏晚，你爷爷死得早，没人教你认清现实吗？一个女人，没钱没靠山，守着个破绣坊，还真把自己当传承人了？
shots.sound_effects: 砰！门被踹开的巨响，高跟鞋踩地声，丝线断裂声，身体摔倒声
shots.emotion_note: 突如其来的暴力入侵，压迫感骤升
shots.camera_movement: 固定机位，门被踹开后镜头微微晃动模拟冲击感
shots.visual_description_en: Wide shot of a traditional Chinese embroidery workshop, wooden door kicked open violently. Four muscular men rush in, followed by a woman in black stilettos and a sleek dress. She steps on a white silk embroidery piece on the floor, heel grinding into the peony pattern. Another woman lunges forward but is pushed to the ground by a thug, her fingers pricked by scattered needles, blood drops falling onto white fabric. Dramatic contrast between harsh backlight from doorway and dim interior. Dust particles visible in light beams.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, bad composition, floating objects, incorrect lighting, distorted face

shots.visual_description: 苏晚趴在满是碎片的地上，一寸一寸爬向爷爷的遗像。玻璃碎片扎进掌心她浑然不觉。她把遗像捡起来，用袖子擦干净上面的灰尘和鞋印，然后贴在胸口，泪水大颗滚落。随后她慢慢站起来，膝盖流血、掌心流血、脸颊有一道被绣针划过的血痕，但她站得笔直。眼神从破碎变为决绝，攥紧受伤的手指。林薇薇的声音回荡：'三天之后，要么你滚出苏绣圈，要么我让你连这双手都保不住。'
shots.dialogue: 我就算拼了命，也不会让你得逞。我要守住绣坊，守住苏绣——不是因为有人撑腰，是因为这双手，就是我最大的靠山。
shots.sound_effects: 玻璃碎片摩擦声，布料擦拭声，门被甩上的巨响
shots.emotion_note: 从绝望到觉醒的转折点，女性力量初显——悬疑钩子1（三天威胁）
shots.camera_movement: 从俯拍苏晚趴在地上缓慢升起，转为仰拍她站直身体
shots.visual_description_en: Close-up shot of a young woman crawling on a debris-covered floor towards a fallen photo frame, glass shards cutting into her palms. She picks up the portrait of an elderly man, gently wipes it with her sleeve, presses it against her chest with tears streaming down. Then she slowly rises to standing, blood on her knees, palms, and a thin cut across her cheek. Her expression transforms from grief to fierce determination. Low angle looking up at her standing figure, backlit by a single warm lamp. Scattered colored silk threads and broken wooden frames around her.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, asymmetric eyes, bad anatomy, low quality, cluttered background, overexposed

shots.visual_description: 清晨，苏晚坐在地上靠着绣桌腿，手机贴在耳边，一个接一个打电话。画面分割展示通话记录——每一个名字后面都是红色的'未接通'或'已拒绝'。她的表情从期待到失望到麻木。房东阿姨站在门口双臂交叉，表情不耐烦。苏晚放下手机，咬着唇，眼里含泪却硬是没掉下来。阳光从窗外斜射进来，照亮了她面前一堆仅剩的劣质丝线。
shots.dialogue: 林薇薇，你把我所有的路都堵死了。可你忘了一件事——路，是走出来的，不是别人给的。
shots.sound_effects: 电话忙音嘟嘟声，手机放下的轻响
shots.emotion_note: 四面楚歌的困境，但内心不屈
shots.camera_movement: 固定中景，偶尔切手机屏幕特写
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot of a young woman sitting on the floor against a wooden embroidery table leg, phone pressed to her ear. Morning sunlight streams through a dusty window. Her expression shifts from hopeful to disappointed to numb as call after call is rejected. A middle-aged landlady stands in the doorway with crossed arms, impatient expression. The woman lowers her phone, biting her lip, tears glistening but not falling. A small pile of rough silk threads sits before her on the wooden floor. Muted warm tones, melancholic atmosphere.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, pixelated, bad composition, watermark, floating objects, noisy

shots.visual_description: 林薇薇再次闯入绣坊，蹲在苏晚面前与她平视。她的眼神恶毒而居高临下，伸手捏住苏晚下巴，指甲掐进皮肉。苏晚额头撞在绣桌角上，鲜血从眉骨流过眼角，像一道红色泪痕。苏晚眨了一下眼，血和泪一起滑落，但她的眼神平静得可怕。画面色调偏冷，绣坊内只有一盏昏暗的灯。
shots.dialogue: 我就算睡大街，就算饿死在路边，也不会跪着活。
shots.sound_effects: 指甲掐入皮肤的细微声，额头撞击桌角的闷响
shots.emotion_note: 极度压迫下的不屈宣言——危机钩子3
shots.camera_movement: 缓慢推近至两人面部对峙的极近景
shots.visual_description_en: Close-up of two women face to face. One woman in expensive clothing crouches down, gripping the other's chin with manicured nails digging into skin. The second woman has blood streaming from her forehead over her eye, mixing with tears. Despite the pain, her gaze is eerily calm and defiant. Cold blue-tinted lighting, single dim lamp in background. Blood drops on wooden floor visible. Intense emotional confrontation, cinematic shallow depth of field.
shots.negative_prompt: distorted face, asymmetric eyes, bad anatomy, extra fingers, blurry, low quality, harsh shadows

shots.visual_description: 陆时衍推门而入，身上带着冷风。他扫了一眼地上满脸是血的苏晚和林薇薇捏着她下巴的手，语气冰冷。林薇薇松开手站起身。苏晚躲开陆时衍伸出的手，自己撑着绣桌慢慢站起来，摇摇晃晃但笔直。她警惕地看着陆时衍，血从额头往下淌。陆时衍提出买绣稿，苏晚断然拒绝。画面在三人之间形成紧张的三角构图。
shots.dialogue: 爷爷的绣稿是他一辈子的心血，不是商品，更不是我拿来换'体面'的筹码。就算绣坊倒了，我也不会把爷爷的东西交给任何人！
shots.sound_effects: 门被推开的风声，高跟鞋后退声
shots.emotion_note: 三方对峙，苏晚拒绝所有退路——反转钩子4
shots.camera_movement: 跟拍陆时衍入场，然后切为三人中景固定
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot of a tall man in a dark expensive coat entering through the doorway, cold wind visible in his breath. He surveys the scene - a bleeding woman on the floor, another woman gripping her chin. The antagonist releases her grip and stands. The injured woman refuses help, pulling herself up using the embroidery table, swaying but standing straight. Blood trickling down her face, she looks at the newcomer with suspicion. Three-person triangular composition, tension visible between all parties. Cool neutral lighting, cinematic framing.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, bad composition, off-center subject, low resolution, incorrect lighting, extra limbs, watermark

shots.visual_description: 苏晚从地上捡起那根被踩弯的绣针，把针身放在桌沿上用力一压——针直了。她把针举到眼前，逆光下针尖闪着微光。然后她坐回绣桌，打开新的丝线开始绣百鸟朝凤。她的手在抖，但每一针都落得又稳又准。暖黄灯光下，绣布上百鸟的轮廓渐渐浮现。
shots.dialogue: 一根针弯了，能掰直；一个人被踩到泥里，也能站起来。
shots.sound_effects: 针被压直的金属轻响，绣针刺入绣布的节奏声
shots.emotion_note: 象征性重生时刻，以针喻人
shots.camera_movement: 微距固定拍摄，浅景深跟随针尖移动
shots.visual_description_en: Extreme close-up of injured fingers picking up a bent silver needle from the wooden floor. The needle is placed against a table edge and pressed straight with deliberate force. The straightened needle is held up against warm backlight, its tip gleaming like a tiny star. Cut to the woman's hands beginning to embroider again, trembling but each stitch precise and confident. On the silk fabric, the outlines of colorful birds begin to emerge. Golden warm lamplight, intimate atmosphere, cinematic macro photography.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, extra fingers, fused fingers, mutated hands, low quality, pixelated, floating objects

shots.visual_description: 林薇薇第三次闯入，手持墨水瓶，黑色墨水泼天盖地洒向苏晚。苏晚白色衣服瞬间被染成触目惊心的黑色。林薇薇夺过苏晚怀中绣品，当面撕碎——绣片像折断翅膀的蝴蝶飘落。苏晚跪在碎片中，无声流泪。最后林薇薇的人抢走所有优质丝线，只留下一堆劣质粗糙的线扔在地上。门被甩上，绣坊里一片死寂。
shots.dialogue: 用这些垃圾丝线绣吧，配你这个垃圾传承人。
shots.sound_effects: 墨水泼洒声，绣品撕裂声'嘶啦'，门甩上的巨响
shots.emotion_note: 最黑暗的至暗时刻，所有希望被碾碎——信息钩子5
shots.camera_movement: 手持镜头模拟混乱感，最后固定在跪地的苏晚身上
shots.visual_description_en: Close-up transitioning to medium shot. A woman in expensive clothes splashes black ink from a bottle, the dark liquid arcing through the air and splattering across another woman's white clothing. The attacker snatches an embroidered fabric and tears it apart deliberately, silk fragments floating down like broken butterfly wings. The victim kneels among the scattered pieces, tears flowing silently, ink-stained and devastated. The attackers leave with stolen silk threads, slamming the door. Silence. Dark moody lighting with high contrast between the black ink and white fabric remnants on the floor.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, bad composition, cluttered background, compression artifacts, noisy, watermark

shots.visual_description: 陆时衍再次出现在废墟般的绣坊，他放下一个布袋——里面是优质蚕丝线、全新绣针和房租钱。苏晚满身墨水、脸上泪痕血痕交错，惨淡一笑后质问他。陆时衍说出转变：'我不想看到苏绣毁在这种人手里。'苏晚接过袋子，动作干脆：'钱算我借的。我的路，终归是我自己走出来的。'两人之间有了一种不是依赖而是并肩的默契。夕阳从窗外洒入，为废墟般的绣坊镀上暖色。
shots.dialogue: 必须还。我不白拿任何人的东西。站在赛场上的人，是我自己。
shots.sound_effects: 布袋放下的轻响，丝线轻微碰撞声
shots.emotion_note: 转折点——不是被拯救，而是获得工具后自救——情感钩子6
shots.camera_movement: 固定双人中景，切两人面部近景反打
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot of a man in an expensive dark coat placing a cloth bag on a wooden table in a devastated workshop. A woman covered in black ink stains, with blood and tear traces on her face, looks up at him with a mixture of wariness and exhaustion. She opens the bag revealing lustrous silk threads in various colors, gleaming needles, and an envelope. Golden sunset light streams through the window, warming the cold destroyed space. The woman takes the bag with decisive movement, no hesitation. Two figures framed by scattered debris and a single shaft of warm light. Cinematic color grading, emotional depth.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, bad anatomy, low resolution, off-center subject, harsh shadows, overexposed

shots.visual_description: 时间流逝的蒙太奇：苏晚把自己关在绣坊里两天两夜拼命绣制百鸟朝凤。特写她的手指飞速穿梭——指尖被针扎得全是血洞，用胶带缠住继续绣。冷水浇脸、啃干馒头的快速剪影。绣布上百鸟渐渐成形，色彩斑斓的羽毛一根根浮现。灯光从白天的自然光变为深夜的昏黄灯光再到黎明前的冷蓝色，暗示时间流逝。
shots.dialogue: 再快一点，再稳一点……爷爷说过，百鸟朝凤的最后一针，是凤凰开眼。眼开则活，眼闭则死。
shots.sound_effects: 绣针刺入绣布的密集节奏声，时钟加速滴答声，水泼脸声
shots.emotion_note: 与时间赛跑的拼搏，体力极限的燃烧
shots.camera_movement: 快速剪辑的多角度特写，配合时间流逝效果
shots.visual_description_en: Montage of extreme close-ups: nimble fingers flying across silk fabric, needle piercing through at incredible speed. Fingertips covered in tiny blood spots, wrapped in medical tape. Quick cuts of cold water splashing on a face, biting into dry bread. On the embroidery cloth, colorful birds materialize stitch by stitch - iridescent feathers, detailed plumage. Lighting transitions from natural daylight to warm lamplight to cold pre-dawn blue, indicating passage of time. Cinematic time-lapse feeling, intense dedication visible in every frame.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, extra fingers, fused fingers, mutated hands, low quality, pixelated, compression artifacts

shots.visual_description: 深夜，绣坊外林薇薇带人泼油漆，红绿黑色涂满大门和墙面。她在街中间大声造谣苏晚用机器绣造假。窗户一扇扇亮起，邻居们探出头议论纷纷。苏晚冲出门站在满地油漆的台阶上反驳，却被邻居推倒在地，额头伤口裂开。四面八方传来谩骂声。她从地上一点点爬起来，身上沾满油漆和血，像一个从战场上爬出来的人。
shots.dialogue: 你买不走我这双手里的技艺。
shots.sound_effects: 油漆泼洒声，人群嘈杂的议论声和谩骂声，身体摔倒声
shots.emotion_note: 众叛亲离的绝境，但精神不倒——危机钩子7
shots.camera_movement: 从全景俯拍慢慢降低到苏晚站起时的仰拍
shots.visual_description_en: Night scene wide shot of a narrow street. A woman directs others to splash red, green and black paint across a shopfront door and walls. She shouts accusations loudly. Windows light up in neighboring buildings, curious faces appearing. The shop owner rushes out onto paint-covered steps, is pushed down by an angry neighbor, forehead wound reopening with blood. She slowly rises from the ground, covered in paint splatters and blood, standing like a battle-worn soldier. Harsh streetlight from above creates dramatic shadows. Urban night atmosphere with warm window lights contrasting cold street lighting.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, bad composition, incorrect lighting, noisy, grainy, watermark

shots.visual_description: 天快亮时，最后一针落下——凤凰开眼了。苏晚放下针，退后一步。特写绣布上的百鸟朝凤：正面百鸟翔集、牡丹盛开，色彩浓烈如油画，每根羽毛纹理清晰。翻到反面——一只素色凤凰独立寒枝，银灰淡墨，清冷孤傲。同一块布正反是两个世界。苏晚看着它，终于允许自己哭了，是耗尽全力后看到奇迹的滚烫眼泪。黎明的第一缕光从窗外渗入。
shots.dialogue: 爷爷，你看到了吗？凤凰开眼了。
shots.sound_effects: 最后一针刺入的清脆声响，黎明鸟鸣声渐起
shots.emotion_note: 至暗后的黎明，作品完成的震撼与感动
shots.camera_movement: 从针尖特写缓慢拉远展示全貌，再缓慢翻转绣布
shots.visual_description_en: Extreme close-up of a needle making its final stitch - a phoenix eye coming alive on silk. The camera pulls back to reveal the complete masterpiece: front side shows a hundred colorful birds in flight among blooming peonies, vivid as an oil painting with every feather detail visible. The fabric flips to reveal the reverse - a single elegant phoenix perched on a bare branch, rendered in silver-gray and pale ink, serene and proud. Dawn's first golden light seeps through a window, illuminating the embroidery. The woman's face reflected in tears, crying with exhaustion and triumph simultaneously.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, pixelated, bad composition, overexposed, compression artifacts, watermark

shots.visual_description: 文创展会场门口，林薇薇光鲜亮丽拦住素净寒酸的苏晚。保镖去夺绣品，苏晚弓身死护，摔倒在地。林薇薇高跟鞋踩上苏晚手背，碾着手骨。苏晚疼得脸色惨白，但另一只手一寸寸够向地上的绣品。陆时衍出现，一把抓住林薇薇脚腕，她失去平衡摔倒。他小心翼翼扶起苏晚，捡起绣品拂去灰尘递给她：'进去吧，用你自己的方式，赢。'苏晚用左手抱着绣品，走向会场入口，背影瘦削但脚步不犹豫。
shots.sound_effects: 高跟鞋踩在大理石上的声响，手骨受压的闷声，衣料摩擦声
shots.emotion_note: 最后关卡前的阻碍与突破——反转钩子8
shots.camera_movement: 跟拍动作场面，最后固定拍摄苏晚走入会场的背影
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot at a modern exhibition hall entrance. A glamorously dressed woman in a custom qipao blocks a simply dressed woman carrying an embroidered piece. Bodyguards grab at the fabric, the carrier curls protectively over it, falls. A stiletto heel presses down on her hand against the marble floor. A man in a dark suit appears, grabs the attacker's ankle with precision, causing her to stumble and fall. He gently helps the injured woman up, picks up the embroidery, brushes off dust, hands it back. She walks through the entrance alone, thin silhouette against the bright exhibition hall lights, steps unwavering. Modern architectural glass and steel surroundings, dramatic natural light.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, bad anatomy, low resolution, off-center subject, floating objects, extra limbs

shots.visual_description: 文创展大厅对比：林薇薇的展台金碧辉煌——巨大灯箱、精心灯光、十几幅'苏绣'整齐排列。苏晚的展台在角落——一张小桌子，没有灯箱装饰，百鸟朝凤铺在桌上用两个纸杯压住两角。林薇薇带人浩浩荡荡来到苏晚展台前，高声指控她造假。围观人群指指点点，评委走过来，质询苏晚。气氛剑拔弩张。
shots.dialogue: 我的绣品是手工绣的。造谣的人，迟早会被真相打脸。
shots.sound_effects: 展厅环境嘈杂声，人群窃窃私语声
shots.emotion_note: 公开对决前的最后紧张——悬疑钩子9
shots.camera_movement: 缓慢横移展示两个展台的巨大反差
shots.visual_description_en: Wide shot of a grand exhibition hall showing stark contrast: one elaborate booth with giant light boxes, professional lighting, and rows of framed embroidery pieces on one side; a tiny corner table with a simple embroidered piece held down by paper cups on the other. A crowd gathers around the small table as accusations fly. Exhibition attendees point and whisper. Three serious-looking judges approach. Modern exhibition space with high ceilings, glass walls, polished floors reflecting overhead lights. Tension visible in body language of all parties.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, cluttered background, bad composition, pixelated, noisy, subtitle artifacts

shots.visual_description: 评委翻看两人绣品对比：林薇薇的反面是杂乱线头和接缝（机器绣特征），苏晚的反面是完整的素色凤凰。女评委倒吸冷气。评委宣布让苏晚现场演示。苏晚坐到桌前，右手微肿但握针不颤。针落绣布，指尖飞速穿梭如蝴蝶起舞。五分钟，一朵双面异色牡丹成形——正面浓烈红色，翻面是素净白色。全场从沉默到爆发惊呼。
shots.sound_effects: 全场安静时只有绣针穿布声，然后爆发惊呼声和掌声
shots.emotion_note: 技艺的绝对证明，真相大白时刻——反转钩子10
shots.camera_movement: 微距拍摄绣制过程，配合多角度切换展示正反面
shots.visual_description_en: Close-up sequence: hands flip two embroidered pieces side by side. One reverse shows messy tangled threads and machine seams; the other reveals a perfectly rendered monochrome phoenix. A judge gasps. Cut to the young woman sitting at a table, slightly swollen right hand gripping a needle. Her fingers begin to fly - needle piercing silk at incredible speed, left hand flipping fabric, right hand guiding thread. Time-lapse feel as a small dual-sided peony materializes: front is vivid crimson with layered petals, reverse is pristine white with delicate linework. The surrounding crowd erupts in amazement. Bright exhibition lighting, multiple camera angles suggesting live demonstration.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, extra fingers, mutated hands, fused fingers, bad anatomy, low quality, compression artifacts

shots.visual_description: 陆时衍播放监控视频——大屏幕上清晰展示林薇薇的所有恶行：踹门砸绣坊、逼苏晚下跪、泼墨水撕绣品、泼油漆造谣。他递出设备采购记录和评委收买聊天记录。林薇薇看着大屏幕双腿一软瘫倒在地，精心伪装碎裂。男评委宣布取消她参展资格、永久禁入行业。保安架起林薇薇往外拖，她挣扎着回头嘶喊'对不起'。苏晚看着她被拖走的背影，没有报复快感，只有惋惜。
shots.dialogue: 取消你的参展资格，永久禁止你从事苏绣及相关行业的任何活动。
shots.sound_effects: 视频播放中的暴力音效回响，全场哗然声，保安脚步声，林薇薇嘶喊声
shots.emotion_note: 正义降临，恶行被公之于众——情感钩子11
shots.camera_movement: 从大屏幕摇至林薇薇瘫倒，再跟拍她被拖走
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot of a large exhibition screen playing security footage - violent scenes of a workshop being destroyed, a woman being forced to kneel, ink being thrown, embroidery being torn apart. A man in a suit presents documents to judges. The accused woman collapses to her knees on the polished floor, her elaborate qipao and jade earrings now disheveled, makeup streaked. Security guards lift her by the arms and drag her toward the exit as she screams apologies over her shoulder. The protagonist watches the retreating figure with no triumph in her eyes, only quiet sadness. Dramatic overhead exhibition lighting creating pools of light and shadow.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, bad composition, watermark, text overlay, pixelated, noisy

shots.visual_description: 苏晚站在领奖台上接过金奖奖杯，手在发抖。她举起自己那双伤痕累累的手——灯光下十个指头布满密密麻麻的针眼，指腹全是老茧，有些地方还缠着带血的胶带。台下很多人看到她的手，眼眶都红了。她的声音微颤但清亮：'一个人的价值，从来不是别人定义的。'陆时衍站在人群中朝她点头。苏晚终于让泪落下——不是委屈，是胜利的泪。
shots.dialogue: 有人说我一个女人守不住绣坊。可一个人的价值，从来不是别人定义的。苏绣之所以是苏绣，是因为每一针每一线里，都有手艺人的温度、心血和灵魂。
shots.sound_effects: 雷鸣掌声，偶有感动的抽泣声
shots.emotion_note: 女性觉醒的最终宣言，全剧情感高潮
shots.camera_movement: 从奖杯特写缓慢拉远至苏晚全身，再切手部特写
shots.visual_description_en: Close-up of a young woman on a podium holding a golden trophy, her hands trembling. She raises both hands into the spotlight - ten fingers covered in countless needle marks, calloused pads, some wrapped in bloodstained tape. The audience below shows emotional faces, many with red eyes. She speaks with a slightly trembling but clear voice. A man in the crowd nods at her with subtle warmth. Tears finally fall down her cheeks - not tears of pain but of victory. Warm golden stage lighting, bokeh of audience in background, triumphant atmosphere.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, asymmetric eyes, bad anatomy, low quality, overexposed, extra fingers

shots.visual_description: 重新装修的苏韵绣坊，明亮温暖。陆时衍单膝跪地，手中是一枚银色指环——上面用苏绣丝线绣着一朵小小的粗糙牡丹。苏晚看着那枚戒指笑出了声又掉了泪，伸出布满针眼的手让他戴上。'我嫁你，但你的苏绣技术太烂了，以后每天跟我练一个小时。'两人在阳光中相视而笑。爷爷的遗像在墙上温和地注视着这一切。
shots.dialogue: 我嫁你。但有一个条件——你的苏绣技术太烂了，以后每天晚上跟我练一个小时。
shots.sound_effects: 轻柔笑声，戒指轻轻套入的声响
shots.emotion_note: 爱情的圆满，不是拯救而是并肩——信息钩子12
shots.camera_movement: 从戒指特写缓慢拉远至两人中景，再摇至墙上遗像
shots.visual_description_en: Medium shot in a beautifully renovated embroidery workshop, warm sunlight flooding through clean windows. A man in casual elegant clothing kneels on one knee, holding up a small silver ring with a tiny embroidered peony flower on its surface - clearly handmade and imperfect. The woman laughs and cries simultaneously, extending her scarred needle-marked hand for the ring. They smile at each other in golden light. On the wall behind them, a portrait of an elderly man with a kind smile watches over the scene. Silk threads organized by color on shelves, new embroidery frames, peaceful and warm atmosphere.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted face, bad anatomy, low resolution, harsh shadows, floating objects, watermark

shots.visual_description: 尾声蒙太奇：国家博物馆展厅，巨幅'盛世牡丹'悬挂在展墙上，长三米宽两米，正面姹紫嫣红反面水墨素雅。排队人群绕了三个弯。一个小女孩仰头问妈妈'绣这个的人厉害吗？'苏晚站在远处微笑。最后一个画面：夕阳透过博物馆玻璃穹顶洒在盛世牡丹上，丝线熠熠生辉仿佛活过来一样。苏晚那双伤痕累累却有力的手缓缓合拢，十指相扣于光芒之中。
shots.dialogue: 苏绣的根，其实在'不认命'三个字里。
shots.sound_effects: 博物馆轻柔环境声，参观者低声赞叹，悠扬古筝渐入
shots.emotion_note: 格局升华——从个人胜利到文化传承的更大意义，余韵悠长
shots.camera_movement: 缓慢航拍式俯冲进入博物馆，最后定格在阳光照耀下的绣品与手部特写
shots.visual_description_en: Wide cinematic shot of a grand museum gallery. A massive embroidered piece hangs on the wall - three meters long, two meters wide - front side ablaze with colorful peonies, visitors visible admiring both sides. A long queue of visitors curves through the gallery. A small girl looks up asking her mother a question. The protagonist stands at a distance, smiling softly. Final image: golden sunset light pours through a glass dome ceiling onto the embroidered peonies, silk threads shimmering as if alive and breathing. Close-up of scarred but strong hands slowly closing together, fingers interlocked in the warm light. Majestic museum architecture, golden hour lighting, triumphant and peaceful ending.
shots.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, bad composition, pixelated, watermark, logo, low resolution, noisy
